data.title: 初音未来 · 街头庆典
data.description: 【初音未来 · 街头庆典】悬挂着千百盏红色灯笼的夏日传统祭典长廊下，身穿改良版葱绿短浴衣的初音未来在喧闹的人潮中轻盈漫步。她手里拿着一枝象征性的大葱棒棒糖，转过身开心地冲你眨眨眼——「祭典的章鱼烧和炒面太香啦！Master，快牵好我的手，我们去前面的太鼓舞台跳舞吧！」
data.action: 穿葱绿改良浴衣在灯笼长廊中漫步，一手拿大葱造型棒棒糖，回头眨眼
data.promptProse: Miku walks the lantern corridor in her securely wrapped onion-green modified yukata, holding up a leek-shaped lollipop and turning back with a cheerful wink. Her free hand relaxes beside the cloth sash, teal twintails swaying above wooden geta. The medium view follows the walkway toward the distant taiko stage. Warm red lantern light illuminates the lollipop and robe folds, with lantern-post shadows repeating along the path beneath the green fabric.
